messages:
ashwin: Thinking about shipping a trace-derived latency SLO in Console: per-route P95/P99 with a latency breakdown (ingress, model decode, KV cache, external DB). Need a concrete plan for exporter retention, sampling, and cardinality so the numbers are stable and affordable.
joanna: big yes on the breakdown. main practical q: how do we avoid query cost explosion if we store full spans for every request?
tomo: +1 for aggregated histograms at the collector. emit summaries (route+model) and keep a small fraction of full traces for tail/debugging.
natalie: Also: partial traces are going to be common (missing DB spans). how do we attribute latency when spans are absent? fallback to an "unknown" bucket? :thinking:
ashwin: proposal: collector-side summary exporter that emits metrics per-route/model/rough-tenant and keeps full traces only for: errors, P99+ latency, and canary samples. Example metric config sketch: 

```
metrics:
  - name: route_latency_histogram
    labels: [route, model, tenant_bucket]
    buckets: [10,50,100,300,1000,3000]
    aggregation: histogram
```

This keeps query costs bound while preserving a path to inspect tails. Keep metrics long-term; retain sampled full traces for 7d.
joanna: we still have the cardinality problem with tenant_id. we need coarse bucketing or hashing for low-cardinality metrics.
tomo: agree — hash tenant -> 1000 buckets or keep tenant label only for enterprise tier. free-tier uses aggregated customer=public.
natalie: from alerting perspective, Console should let teams choose SLI source: metric histogram (cheap) vs traces (more accurate). Also define span->error mapping: status.code != OK OR http.status >= 500 => failure. This is what drives error-budget.
ashwin: good call. compute error_budget_burn as rate(root_span_errors) / allowed_error_rate. root span detection relies on request id dedupe. Need to guard against retries inflating counts.
infra-bot: deploy queued: otel-collector config PR #842 pushed to canary cluster.
joanna: TL;DR for rollout steps?
ashwin: 1) implement histogram exporter in collector (canary) 2) emit metrics + sampled traces for 10% traffic 3) wire Console SLO UI to metrics-backed view, with toggle to drill into traces 4) monitor cost/slo variance for 2 weeks 5) expand sampling or change bucketing as needed.
tomo: edge case: server-side retries create duplicated root spans — dedupe by x-request-id at aggregation time. Also consider attributing retry time to original attempt vs total.
natalie: privacy note: some customers forbid traces. default to metrics-only for them and document opt-in for trace-backed SLOs.
joanna: I'll mock a Console panel that shows: overall SLO line, stacked breakdown bars (ingress/model/cache/db/unknown), and a button to view sampled traces for the selected time window. will include a toggle to switch to metrics-only mode. :+1:
ashwin: thanks — I'll follow up with the collector config snippet and the PR link to implement the histogram exporter. we'll also add a checklist for quota handling and billing edge-cases.
